name: – Nils Ušakovs, Michalis Hadjipantela – After § 13 – Am 34
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2027
part_text: 13d. Points out that, in 2025, 19,3 million children in the Union were at risk of poverty or social exclusion, representing 24,3% of children under the age of 18; believes, therefore, that the Union budget needs to step up efforts to eradicate poverty among children, including migrant children, children with disabilities, and children living in precarious family situations, strengthening the European Child Guarantee; recalls Parliament’s calls for the creation within the ESF+ of a specific budget line for the European Child Guarantee, with its own dedicated allocation;
